title: Tristan Zatylny’s Resume
text:
Software Engineer and Computer Science Student.

tristanzatylny@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/tristan-zatylny | github.com/tristanzat | (512) 745-5286 | Download PDF



Software Engineer Intern at Portnox, building experience with day-to-day ticket resolution, local testing, code review workflows, and AI-assisted development inside Visual Studio and Azure DevOps.


Software engineering, AI-assisted development, collaborative product work, and practical full-stack problem solving.




Jun. 2025 - Current Software Engineer Intern, Portnox, Austin, TX

Resolved assigned tickets in a timely manner.
Leveraged AI-assisted development tools within Visual Studio to accelerate ticket resolution and improve code efficiency.
Tested code changes locally before creating pull requests to verify expected behavior.
Managed end-to-end development work using Azure DevOps for version control, code reviews, and pull request integration.
Completed security training modules required for software development and operations.
Worked with automated AI code review systems to maintain code quality and align with best practices.
Collaborated remotely with coworkers in Europe to learn the product’s design and code standards.







Used agile scrum methodology to develop the product with a team.
Gathered user feedback and implemented it into the product.
Used integrated AI tools to refine summarizer prompts.
Utilized GitHub for version control and Firebase for backend AI limiting.





Coordinated team efforts in developing a Python game for the i-Hack 2025: Hack the Norm hackathon, placing first in the entertainment category.
Managed user interface and logic design.
Utilized AI agent tools to optimize game performance and implement pathfinding logic.
Used GitHub for version control.






Languages: Java, Python, C#, C++, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
Tools and Platforms: Visual Studio, VS Code, Azure DevOps, GitHub




Current Brigham Young University-Idaho

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science in progress.





Served a 2-year full-time mission for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in Pocatello, Idaho.
